headline: ENGINE SHIPPED, EPICS DECOMPOSED, BACKLOG HONEST (2026-09-19). The shared Ralph engine v1 advanced to a4f0c21 fleet-wide with Adrian’s approval: ralph#23 makes orphan-branch recovery pick the NEWEST branch and name the ones it passed over, and ralph#24 fixes the kit-drift check to compare against the engine revision actually RUNNING rather than hirobius/ralph main — ops, hds and site-engine were all re-vendored and the next gate run reported the vendored kit in sync. AUTO-MERGE IS NOW CONDITIONAL by Adrian’s decision (ops#401): tag ralph-auto only on an issue whose DoD names no supervised path, because the engine’s arm has no path check and a blanket tag is what let #368 and #362 merge lead-handling diffs unreviewed. ORDER THAT MUST NOT BE REVERSED: Ralph#25 (engine-side path check) lands BEFORE ops#402 (flip the default), or the flip deletes the revenue-path boundary #375 added — today that boundary is a human convention, not a mechanism. Two epics were decomposed into 15 filed children (ops#238, site-engine#153); se#205, #206 and #207 of that chain shipped — the two V1 bespoke pages are now byte-identical, driven entirely by site.spec.ts and a generated design.css. Three environment-dependent gate bugs were fixed where CI was green and the developer machine red (Windows path separators, filename case, a missing binary), and hds CI was found to have NEVER run its 9-gate pretest chain — it does now. THE STANDING PAGE’S ISSUE TOTAL IS WRONG until ops#405 lands: GET /issues?filter=all spans every visible repo (209 rows) and only 95 are the fleet; job-hunt, the one repo sessions are told never to touch, is the single largest contributor at 32. Open-PR counts are correct. Fleet open issues: ops 32, hds 21, site-engine 22, Ralph 6, concrete 9, folio 5. Of 90 audited, only 15 are agent-actionable — the backlog is un-queueable, not unqueued. THE FUNNEL STILL READS 0 CONTACTED.
next: ops#380, #387, #378, #384 are open and each waits on a human: #380 needs the OPS_AGENT_KEY Actions secret; #387 needs Supabase migration 0015 plus the import run by Adrian (it writes production); #378 is a draft needing a real eval run and ralph-approved; #384 is a draft that waits for the new hirobius.com to exist.
